info.title: JanMaang API
info.description: Civic demand-to-budget platform. A citizen reports a local need; AI structures it; identical reports cluster; the cluster is ranked, funded, executed and citizen-verified.

get.description: Officers a department may assign: same district and department only.
Anonymous aggregate only. Reporter identity and exact coordinates stay private.

ProblemStatus.title: ProblemStatus
ProblemStatus.description:
The agreed report lifecycle. Mirrored by the Flutter mapping in
apps/mobile/lib/features/report/data/report_dto.dart and documented in
docs/api/day1-frontend-contract.md — change all three together.

VERIFIED means validated by the Panchayat. Citizen confirmation of a repair
is CITIZEN_VERIFIED.

PublicTransparency.title: PublicTransparency
PublicTransparency.description:
Anonymous aggregate counts; complaints and grouped cases are distinct.

Until any live (non-demo) report exists, the totals describe the labelled
demonstration data and `sample_data` is true. Once live reports exist,
only live records are counted. Sample and live figures are never mixed.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Every role in JanMaang.

CITIZEN is the mobile app's role and has no web dashboard; the other nine
are web roles.
